fields.name: Available Phosphorus (P) content
fields.abstract: Important part of the bioavailable fraction of phosphorus. Valid for cropland and grassland Olsen method only

fields.name: Base Saturation (BS) exchangeable activity
fields.abstract: Percentage of exchangeable bases (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, K⁺, Na⁺) occupying negatively charged sorption sites (Costantini, 2007). It is valid only for cropland

fields.name: Base Saturation (BS) soil structure
fields.abstract: Percentage of exchangeable bases (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, K⁺, Na⁺) occupying negatively charged sorption sites (Costantini, 2007). It expresses the potential soil structure degradation risk.

fields.name: Bulk Density (BD)
fields.abstract: Mass of dry soil per unit total volume (considering pore volume) impacting root growth differently in function of the soil texture. Legend classes depend on the texture

fields.name: Cadmium (Cd)
fields.abstract: Cadmium content

fields.name: Carbonate content
fields.abstract: Carbonates (e.g. CaCO3, MgCO3) content

fields.name: Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC)
fields.abstract: Cation Exchange Capacity at buffered pH, valid for cropland

fields.name: Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) / Clay ratio
fields.abstract: Indicator of low or high charge density clays (including swelling clays) (Stewart & Hossner, 2001)

fields.name: Chromium (Cr)
fields.abstract: Chromium (Cr) content

fields.name: Cobalt (Co)
fields.abstract: Cobalt (Co) content

fields.name: Copper (Cu)
fields.abstract: Copper (Cu) content

fields.name: Crust Cover
fields.abstract: Crust cover: percentage of area covered. Valid for arid and desert environment ( BWh, BWk, BSh and BSk)

fields.name: Cryptogram Cover
fields.abstract: Cryptogram Cover: percentage of area covered. Cover of cryptogams, only, visible on the soil surface within the ground stratum vegetation types: biological crust (CR), fungi (NF), lichens (NL), mosses (NM) and peat (NP) (Tongway & Hindley, 2005)

fields.name: C/N ratio
fields.abstract: C/N ratio. Valid on the first layer only. It depends on land use

fields.name: Effective Cation Exchange Capacity (ECEC)
fields.abstract: Effective Cation Exchange Capacity (ECEC). Concentration of negatively charge exchangeable sites at soil pH (Julien & Tessier, 2021). Valid only if CEC/Clay<0.24 in cropland

fields.name: Field Capacity (FC)
fields.abstract: Volumetric water content remaining in the soil after gravitational drainage has become negligible; the interpretation takes soil texture into account.

fields.name: Gravel

fields.abstract: Indicator of anthropogenically impacted soils based on the relative contents of Pb (Weng et al., 2003)

fields.name: Litter Layer

fields.name: Manganese (Mn)

fields.abstract: Mercury (Hg) content

fields.name: Total Soil Nitrogen (N)
fields.abstract: Total Soil Nitrogen (N). Valid for cropland and grassland

fields.name: Ammonium ion (NH4+)
fields.abstract: Ammonium ion (NH4+). Exchangeable ammonium cation. Valid for cropland

fields.name: Nichel (Ni)

fields.name: Nitrate ion (NO3-)
fields.abstract: Soluble nitrate cation. Valid for cropland

fields.name: Organic Carbon
fields.abstract: Organic Carbon content

fields.name: Organic Matter
fields.abstract: Organic Matter content

fields.name: Oxygen availability for roots
fields.abstract: Oxygen availability for roots. Relative gas diffusion coefficient at water field capacity. Valid for grassland and cropland in topsoils

fields.name: Phosphorus Threshold for Plant growth
fields.abstract: Phosphorus threshold for plant growth. Potential positive impact on productivity following phosphorus fertilizers (for cropland in rainfed system and grassland and P Olsen method only). Ratio of the Olsen extracted phosphorus on a calculated threshold under which phosphorus input has positive yield response

fields.name: Packing density
fields.abstract: Measure of soil compaction considering the volume occupied by solid material, excluding pore space (Panagos et al., 2024)

fields.name: Perennial vegetation cover
fields.abstract: Assessment of the degree to which physical surface cover and projected plant cover reduce the effect of raindrops on the soil surface. The ground stratum vegetation type does not include biological crust (CR), fungi (NF), lichens (NL), mosses (NM) and peat (NP); the crop cover is 0 for annual crops and bare soils (NO); PVC is not calculated if land use is an agroforestry system including annual plants (ACA and ACB)

fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to bacterial diversity

fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to fungal activity

fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to toxicity of heavy metals dissolution

fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to microbial carbon use efficiency

fields.name: pH-H2O microbial diversity
fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to microbial diversity

fields.name: pH-H2O organic decomposition
fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to organic matter decomposition

fields.name: pH-H2O phosphorus
fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to phosphorus availability with acid phosphorus enzyme activity

fields.name: pH-H2O plant growth
fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to the optimal plant growth. Valid for cropland

fields.name: pH-H2O soil salinity
fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to soil salinity and structural deterioration

fields.name: pH-H2O som for grassland
fields.abstract: pH (H2O) related to redistribution of SOM for bioturbation by earthworm activity in grassland

fields.name: Plant Available Water Capacity (AWC)
fields.abstract: Soil's ability to store and provide water available to plant roots. For rainfed (not working if = GR, SP, DR) cropland and grassland

fields.name: Relative field capacity (RFC)
fields.abstract: Soil's ability to provide an optimal balance between water and air within the total pore volume (Di Prima et al., 2024). For rainfed (not working if = GR, SP, DR) cropland and grassland

fields.name: Slake test
fields.abstract: Aggregate stability index after 10 minutes immersed in water (STAB10)

fields.name: SOC stock
fields.abstract: Stock of soil organic carbon content for one soil layer or horizon, valid for topsoil only and for cropland, grassland, forest

fields.name: Sodicity Salinity Ratio
fields.abstract: Indicator of potential salinity and sodification remediation by gypsum input, without permeability, pH or EC being unbalance; It can be calculated 1) only for topsoil layer, 2) if electrical conductivity is between 0.2 and 20 dS m-1 and 3) if soluble cations and conductivity are measured in saturated paste extract. Valid only for saturated paste extract

fields.name: Sodium Adsorption Ratio (SAR) sodicity
fields.abstract: Sodicity indicator defined as the proportion of soluble sodium divided by the square root of the sum of soluble calcium and magnesium concentrations measured in saturated paste extracts (Ali, 2011). Valid only for saturated paste extract

fields.name: Sodium Adsorption Ratio (SAR) toxicity
fields.abstract: Sodicity indicator on toxicity for the cultivation of sensitive crops in rainfed crop system only (e.g. agrum trees). Valid only for saturated paste extract and for irrigated cropland

fields.name: Sodium Exchangeable Percentage (ESP) sodicity
fields.abstract: Sodicity indicator based on exchangeable sodium and cation exchange capacity (CEC) (Ali, 2011)

fields.name: Sodium Exchangeable Percentage (ESP) waterlogging
fields.abstract: Waterlogging indicator based on exchangeable sodium and cation exchange capacity (CEC) (Ali, 2011). Valid for irrigated cropland

fields.name: Soil Erodibility by Water
fields.abstract: Indicator of the soil erosion potential based on texture, OM content, soil structure (s) and permeability (p) (Renard et al., 1977, p.74)

fields.name: Soil Erodibility by Wind
fields.abstract: Potential fraction of soil that can be easily moved by the wind (Dufková et al., 2021). Valid for cropland

fields.name: Surface Compaction Risk
fields.abstract: Indicator of potential soil compaction sensitivity, applicable to topsoil only (Costantini, 2007)

fields.name: Total Iron (Fe)
fields.abstract: Total Iron (Fe)

fields.name: Vanadium (V)
fields.abstract: Vanadium (V) content

fields.name: Water Infiltration Potential
fields.abstract: Depth of water infiltration potential in one hour at wilting point

fields.name: Wilting Point
fields.abstract: Volumetric water content at which plants can no longer extract water, resulting in irreversible wilting.

fields.name: Zinc (Zn) relative content
fields.abstract: Indicator of anthropogenically impacted soils based on the relative contents of Zn (Weng et al., 2003)
